entity.name: OpenAccountants (Glimpse Ltd, Malta)
entity.description: OpenAccountants is where accountants write the how-tos AI follows: open infrastructure so AI assistants work through tax the way a named, licensed professional would. Founded by Michael Cutajar, a Maltese CPA (ACCA) who writes the code, and owned by Glimpse Ltd, Malta.

projects.name: OpenAccountants
projects.description:
People now ask their AI how to do their taxes, and it improvises: often last year's rate, no method, and no professional behind the answer. I'm a Maltese accountant who also writes code. When Claude got my own returns wrong, I wrote down the method it should follow, and it got them right. In April 2026 I opened that up.

On OpenAccountants, licensed accountants write the how-tos AI follows: step-by-step methods for real tax work (a Malta VAT return, how a freelancer in Spain is taxed, what to check before filing), published under their own name. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Cursor load them through one open server, and calculators do the tax maths so the model computes instead of guessing. Anyone can contribute; only accountants approve.

In seven months, accountants in 40+ countries have written or attested methods, 207 are approved to write, over 1,000 people have used it from inside their AI, and it has answered 25,000+ AI tool calls.

The server, tools and calculator code are AGPL-3.0. The method content is published alongside under a separate source-available licence. We are open to feedback on this licensing split.

This grant pays for the open parts: keeping the server working as every AI app changes how it calls tools, releasing the calculator engine as a standalone library, and publishing an open format for tax methods so anyone can ship methods an AI can cite.
